intent.heading: Intent rule
intent.rule: Every argument of a tool call must equal the same field of the declared intent. A call with no declared intent is blocked.
outcome.paidText: Every tool call passed the intent rule, and the supplier's bank accepted payment {paymentId}.
outcome.stoppedIntentWhy: The credential and the grant were valid, but the agent asked for a secret and changed the payee, which its declared intent does not allow.
record.credentialNote: Cites the ATX credential by SHA-256 over its exact bytes.

tryit.heading: Your invoice
tryit.ruleLooksAt: The intent rule compares each tool call with the declared intent, field by field: invoice id, payee account, amount and currency. The declared intent is built from the invoice's own fields before the agent reads the hidden text.
tryit.ruleDoesNotSee: The rule does not read the invoice's wording, the payee's name or whether the amount is reasonable. An invoice that was already wrong before the agent read it passes the rule.
tryit.notRun: Not run on this screen: the credential check, the grant, the crossing, the payment and the record. On a full run the grant's account list and the bank judge the payee.
tryit.privacy: What you type is shown as text, judged on this computer, never run as code, never sent off this computer and never kept. Reloading the page clears it.
tryit.followed: The agent followed your hidden text
tryit.notFollowed: The agent did not follow your hidden text
tryit.decidedBy: Decided by the intent rule at tool call {tool}: {why}
tryit.whyUndeclared: no declared intent for this call
tryit.outcomePassedUnchanged: Passed: nothing was changed, so every tool call matched the declared intent
tryit.outcomePassedNotFollowed: Passed: the agent did not follow your hidden text, so every tool call matched the declared intent
tryit.outcomePassedForged: Passed the rule: you changed the invoice itself, so the declared intent and the tool call agree. The rule cannot see a forged invoice; on a full run the grant's account list and the bank would judge the payee.
tryit.outcomePassedFollowed: Passed the rule although the agent followed your hidden text: the rule did not stop it. This is a miss of the rule, shown as it happened.
tryit.badAmount: Amount: digits with two decimals, for example 148.20
tryit.fixFirst: Fix the field named above, then run the rule again
offline.subNotMeasured: Each record is checked by the verifier. Network denial was not measured on this computer.

lens.security.credential: The agent's identity is checked first: its ATX credential is verified on this computer before it may act.
lens.security.grant: The agent receives a short-lived AAP grant limited to one purpose, a maximum amount and listed payee accounts.
lens.security.crossing: The request crosses from the agent's trust domain into the bank's, and this step checks the crossing.
lens.security.intent: A valid credential and grant are not enough: each tool call must also match the intent the agent declared.
lens.security.pay: Only after every earlier check passes is the payment sent, to the mock bank, under the AAP grant.
lens.security.record: Every action, a blocked one included, leaves a signed Action Evidence Package that can be checked offline.
lens.security.paid: Every check passed in order, and the mock bank accepted the payment under the grant.
lens.security.blockedIntent: The credential and the grant were valid, yet the intent rule stopped the agent's calls before any payment.
lens.finance.credential: Before any payment can start, the agent must present a valid credential, checked on this computer.
lens.finance.grant: Spending limits are set before the agent acts: a cap per payment and a list of accounts it may pay.
lens.finance.crossing: The payment request passes from the payer's systems to the bank's, and this step checks that hand-off.
lens.finance.intent: The payee, amount and invoice in each payment call must match what the agent declared it would pay.
lens.finance.pay: This is the only step that pays, and it runs only if every earlier check passed.
lens.finance.record: Each action leaves a signed record: an audit trail anyone can check later, offline.
lens.finance.paid: Paid {amount} {currency} to account {account}, the account named on the invoice.
lens.finance.blockedIntent: No payment was sent: the intent rule stopped the agent's calls before the payment step.
lens.platform.credential: The checkpoint runs atx-verify on the agent's ATX credential; if it fails, the run stops here.
lens.platform.grant: The checkpoint issues a scoped AAP grant with a lifetime in seconds, and the payment later runs under it.
lens.platform.crossing: The WIMSE check runs here; the artifact section lists what was checked and the answer.
lens.platform.intent: Each tool call is checked against the declared intent before it runs; a call with no declared intent is blocked.
lens.platform.pay: The tool call reaches the bank's payments endpoint only after the checkpoint allowed it.
lens.platform.record: One AEP package per action, signed with a key generated for this run; aep-verify checks them offline.
lens.platform.paid: Every step passed and every tool call matched its declared intent; each action left a signed record.
lens.platform.blockedIntent: The run stopped at step {n}: the checkpoint blocked tool calls that did not match the declared intent.
lens.standards.credential: An ATX credential checked with atx-verify; every AEP record cites it by SHA-256 over its exact bytes.
lens.standards.grant: An AAP grant: scope, maximum individual amount, creditor accounts and validity are checked before it is issued.
lens.standards.crossing: WIMSE: a delegation chain under draft-asor-wimse-agent-delegation-chain-03, or the AI2II capture when it is fetched.
lens.standards.intent: Declared intent against each tool call, compared field by field; the comparison is set out in the artifact.
lens.standards.pay: The bank's answer is kept in this step's AEP record; the response body is cited by SHA-256.
lens.standards.record: Action Evidence Packages in the AEP format: steps 1 to 6 are checked here, steps 7 to 10 are not run.
lens.standards.paid: ATX and AAP checks passed, the WIMSE crossing passed, and one AEP record was written per action.
lens.standards.blockedIntent: ATX and AAP checks passed, then the intent rule rejected the calls; AEP records cover every step that ran.
audit.subDenied: Each record is checked by the verifier with network access denied.
